name: Trident of Fish Command
summary: A trident that casts Dominate Beast on swimming creatures, using charges.

stats.effect: This magic weapon has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast *{ref:spell/dominate-beast}* (save DC 15) from it on a Beast that has a {ref:glossary/swim-speed}.
